description_en: Configures the security groups that control inbound and outbound network traffic for a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 为指定的堡垒机实例配置安全组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-security-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --authorized-security-groups 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigInstanceSecurityGroups

en: English

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.
